threads.assignment: Shared contracts only. Export every new public API named in the roadmap from library/src/actions/index.ts and library/src/methods/index.ts (a stub module per API with the exact signature is enough; other threads implement them), add the regular expressions the new validators need to library/src/regex.ts, and make the shared type and utility changes in library/src/types and library/src/utils that the other targets depend on.
Target 1 (guard) and Target 2 (parseBoolean): implement both transformation actions and their tests under library/src/actions/guard and library/src/actions/parseBoolean.
Target 3: implement cache and cacheAsync (with their LRU cache and types) and their tests under library/src/methods/cache.
Target 4 (domain, jwsCompact, isrc validators) and Target 5 (creditCard and isoTimestamp compatibility fixes): implement them and their tests under library/src/actions.
